decisions.reason: The refined lip-sync standard does not change the video count, duration, aspect ratios, or delivery scope.
Lip sync is an independently specified dialogue behavior; its refinement does not necessarily change the existing UGC visual style or general realism criteria.
The dialogue lip-sync standard does not alter color grading, polish, or the required UGC finish.
Audio level and mixing standards are separately addressed by the source message; the lip-sync refinement does not change their values or resolve their ambiguity.
The lip-sync refinement does not change the opening-hook standard or its three-second attention window.
Precise dialogue lip sync does not change the independently accepted mobile-subtitle standard.
The refined lip-sync quality does not change the source or format of testimonial content.
The dialogue lip-sync standard does not alter the content or organic presentation of the call to action.
